context: Parallel coordinates chart showing adversarial audit scores (5 agent dimensions + disagreement σ) across 84 synthetic blocks, with toggle to score-delta mode and brushable axes for filtering
first_impression: Structurally honest parallel coordinates with data-driven y-axis domains and appropriate encoding choices throughout.
what_works: Y-scales are built from d3.extent(vals) across all blocks — data-driven, not hardcoded; brushing correctly filters line visibility without recalculating axis domains from the subset, avoiding jumping axes.
what_doesnt: Color scales use fixed domains (disagreeColorScale: 0–3, deltaColorScale: ±3) rather than data-derived extents, so a real dataset with higher disagreement variance would silently saturate; the mode-switch branch checks 'delta' but the mode variable is set to 'scores'/'delta' inconsistently (btn-delta sets mode='delta' but scoreDims check uses mode==='scores'), a latent bug that may cause incorrect axis formatting on toggle.
